answer: A patch sewn crooked will tear again in the first gale, so the patcher bastes before she stitches, every time. Manila jute cable layer oakum writ rules the basting: a writ jute cable layers sign after cable yard checks. The vertex is the first baste laid, the tide the last before the needle bites, and the zephyr is the needle, threaded with sail twine. A forger faces 47 false bastes and 47 false needles.
